_comment: An iPhone OS project is one app, and whatever it already saved. touchHLE needs nothing else: it carries its own system libraries and fonts.

slots.title: App
slots.help: A DECRYPTED .ipa for iPhone OS 2.x to iOS 4.0. An App Store download is encrypted and will not run; touchHLE's compatibility database (appdb.touchhle.org) says which apps and versions work.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the app already saved, as Emulator > Export Save Data... wrote it: a .zip of the app's Documents and Library folders. It goes back into the app's home before the app starts.
